frozen.counted_success: apple_at_rest_v0 after the settle AND the latched scorer's grasp stage AND its latched place stage, both reached during the attempt's commands, before the settle (owner rulings T71-R1, T71-R2); at rest without both is reported per arm and never counted

o_star_source.roots: the 112 train roots with a counted success (run-1's B-replay library)
o_star_source.statistic: per-step median of apple xy (the stored privileged label) minus the reset plate xy, in cm, at steps t + 16 for every decision step t

H-LeWM: P-3 with R-mid re-reads; W (val-selected seed) ranks the 25 aims
P-stale: P-3 unchanged: the post-look estimates for the whole attempt
P-reread: P-3 with R-mid re-reading the plate at every decision step
H-N: as H-LeWM with the no-action model N (action-blind, run closed loop)
H-shuf: as H-LeWM with the start latent of reset (i + 1) mod n (scene-blind)
H-rand: as H-LeWM with a seeded uniform pick among the same 25 candidates
H-LeWM-s1: H-LeWM with the second W seed (secondary: sign agreement)
H-LeWM-s2: H-LeWM with the third W seed (secondary: sign agreement)
P-truth: P-3 given the true post-shift plate at the shift step (perception ceiling)
H-sim: the same 25 candidates chosen by privileged cloned-state rollouts
B-oracle-shift: e9 built from the post-shift truth (harness; post-shift oracle)
B-random: uniform random within the configured bounds (harness)

frozen.learned_label: a learned policy trained on privileged expert labels (e9, with a privileged DAgger labeller at training time) plus a LeWM critic; not LeWM driving the robot alone, and not the frozen v1 benchmark (owner D2)

k0.h_sim_centre: in K0 the 25 candidates of H-sim are centred on the true post-shift plate (R-mid does not exist before the corpus); from D3 on they are centred on R-mid's incumbent

w_model.latent: frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 final patch tokens pooled to 4 x 4 (TASK-066), 6144-d
w_model.config: token_dynamics.MODEL_CONFIG with the adapter defaults (TASK-066), unchanged

budget.last_two_rule: if any W or N model selects one of its last two selection points, U is raised once to min(2U, 60 000) and all six are retrained; if that still happens at the cap, the run escalates to the owner and nothing is frozen

readouts.R_off: linear ridge (primal, intercept) from the raw pooled token latent (6144-d, train-standardised) to the apple-minus-plate offset xy; rows: apple-shift-v2 train roots at steps 304-592 every 16
readouts.R_mid: linear ridge (dual, intercept) from the full DINOv2 tokens (256 x 384, the P readout's feature, train-standardised) to the plate xy; rows: apple-shift-v2 train roots at the decision steps

frozen.w_seed_selection: the primary W seed is the one with the lowest val criterion at its selected checkpoint among the three; fixed before any closed-loop run

o2.windows: every val root of apple-shift-v2; windows starting at the decision steps t with t >= max(416, shift step) whose true apple-minus-plate offset moves by at least 1 cm over the 16 commands (TASK-054's moving cohort, world_model_v2.MOVING_THRESHOLD_M)

frozen.clause_scope: P-3 proposals plus LeWM frozen-DINOv2-token critic selection on apple-to-plate-v2 at 112 px: no further critic, K, horizon or cost variant is preregistered on apple-shift-v2 or apple-look-v2-linux without new evidence of a different kind. The LeWM backend, the token latent, the v2 task and the planner fallback stay open
frozen.fallback: owner D7 (2026-09-29): TASK-074, the LeWM-only planner (lewm-planner), is pre-authorised as the fallback if TASK-073 ends S-NO-CONDITION, H-NO-HEADROOM or NO-HEADROOM; R-NO-HEADROOM (added here, the offline form of NO-HEADROOM) is proposed to count with them, pending the owner's confirmation; TASK-074 needs its own preregistration, which TASK-073 does not design

devices.corpus_featurisation: cuda, with a CPU anchor check (owner D6)

frozen.void_rule: a guard, a crash, a cap or a CUDA allocation failure makes the stage V and nothing in it is read; batches are never shrunk to fit. A V before the first render of a gated (S or U) seed may be repeated after a reviewed fix; a V after it goes to the owner; a second V closes TASK-073 as INCONCLUSIVE. Development stages (K0, corpus, training, offline, D3) may be repeated once from scratch after a reviewed fix. Nothing is re-thresholded, retrained or re-selected after its numbers are seen
